prompt:
Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas with two cells, RIGHT then LEFT, for the short end-on view of the same Iron Stations horizontal platform edge segment. Use the attached native source, accepted TOP plan, and accepted thin FRONT/REAR side-profile candidates for identity and shared Z scale. The earlier end-view candidate is only a material-detail reference; its proportions were wrong.

Each cell MUST be a broad, shallow horizontal cross-section with target silhouette ratio width:height approximately 134:70 (about 1.9:1). Preserve the full TOP plan Y/depth span of about 134 and the exact common vertical thickness of 70 used by the accepted FRONT/REAR profiles. Do not reduce depth or height. Make the profile a solid gray concrete cap across the full horizontal span, a thin dark rail/support course below it, then a shallow dark base with brown timber blocks. Keep all layers aligned along the same horizontal axis.

Camera directions are strictly orthographic from +X for RIGHT and -X for LEFT, no perspective, no isometric view. These should read as short, broad end profiles of a low platform: horizontal width is noticeably longer than height. No tall post, no vertical stack, no upright yellow tactile panel, no raised-dot panel on the side. The yellow tactile surface belongs only on TOP and is hidden in these end views. Preserve source materials and pixel-art cluster style, isolate each complete object and center it with transparent margins, no labels, shadows or neighboring-cell bleed.
